e.title: reserving-ml
e.summary: 链梯准备金教学实现（Python 3.10+）：发展因子/终极损失/IBNR + 留一对角线回测
e.body: reserving-ml 是 Vaynork（interpretable-tariff 作者）的链梯准备金实现：run-off 三角形上的发展因子、终极损失、IBNR 计算，外加留一对角线（leave-one-diagonal-out）回测——用历史数据验证链梯预测的稳健做法。CI 完备，Python 3.10+。对 RIAA：链梯方法的教学级实现（含回测最佳实践）。与 [[chainladder]]（完整库）、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]]（方法对比）、[[tryangle]]（自动框架）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：链梯准备金（发展因子/终极/IBNR）+ 留一对角线回测，Python 3.10+，CI
e.summary_en: Chain-ladder reserving teaching implementation (Python 3.10+): development factors/ultimates/IBNR + leave-one-diagonal-out backtest
e.summary_hk: 鏈梯準備金教學實現（Python 3.10+）：發展因子/終極損失/IBNR + 留一對角線回測
e.body_en: reserving-ml is Vaynork's (author of interpretable-tariff) chain-ladder reserving implementation: development factors, ultimate losses and IBNR on a run-off triangle, plus a leave-one-diagonal-out backtest — the robust way to validate chain-ladder predictions with historical data. CI-complete, Python 3.10+. For RIAA: a teaching-grade implementation of the chain-ladder method (with backtesting best practice). Complements [[chainladder]] (full library), [[claims-reserving-benchmark]] (method comparison) and [[tryangle]] (automatic framework). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
e.body_hk: reserving-ml 是 Vaynork（interpretable-tariff 作者）的鏈梯準備金實現：run-off 三角形上的發展因子、終極損失、IBNR 計算，外加留一對角線（leave-one-diagonal-out）回測——用歷史數據驗證鏈梯預測的穩健做法。CI 完備，Python 3.10+。對 RIAA：鏈梯方法的教學級實現（含回測最佳實踐）。與 [[chainladder]]（完整庫）、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]]（方法對比）、[[tryangle]]（自動框架）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
